name: Rotate Pages
tagline: Turn sideways or upside-down pages the right way up, all of them or just some.
description: Rotate PDF pages 90 or 180 degrees for free in your browser. Turn every page or just the ones you pick. Nothing is uploaded.

specs.Quality: Lossless: pages are turned, not re-rendered
specs.Works offline: Yes, once the page has loaded

faq.a: No. The PDF is changed inside this browser tab, and the page's security policy blocks it from sending data anywhere.
No. The tool changes each page's rotation setting; nothing is re-rendered or compressed.
